title: The Wall Street Journal quotes Burford expert Jeffery Commission
summary: The Wall Street Journal quotes Jeffery Commission as an expert in an article about the present-day dangers of the mining industry. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*The Wall Street Journal* quotes[Jeffery Commission](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/jeffery-commission/) as an expert in an article about the present-day dangers of the mining industry.


The article states: "'host countries are seeing just how important these minerals are to the U.S. and China,' said Jeffery Commission, a director at Burford Capital, a legal finance company that has funded companies involved in mining disputes."


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.wsj.com/finance/commodities-futures/global-minings-dangerous-new-reality-guns-hostages-arrests-63868366)
